extraction_notes: Target identity established from the catalog entry for C406812 and confirmed by the supplied PDF printing AP2302B and N-Channel Power MOSFET; manufacturer remains the catalog identity ALLPOWER ShenZhen Quan Li Semiconductor.

RDS(on) table rows are transcribed as separate typical and inclusive maximum points: 45 mOhm typical and 55 mOhm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 2.8 A; 55 mOhm typical and 70 mOhm maximum at VGS = 2.5 V, ID = 2.0 A. Both rows are pulse tests with pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.
The body-diode field uses the inclusive maximum VSD of 1.2 V at IS = 0.94 A and VGS = 0 V; the table also publishes a typical value of 0.76 V under the same condition.

Ciss = 300 pF, Coss = 120 pF, and Crss = 80 pF are transcribed from the table at VDS = 10 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz, and converted to farads. No capacitance-versus-VDS figure is present, so no capacitance curve points were invented.

Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation. The VGS = 2.5 V, 3.0 V, and 3.5 V output traces are clipped by the 15 A plot ceiling and were not digitized as separate curves.

The strict schema has no fields for IDSS, gate leakage, gate charge, switching times, forward transconductance, thermal resistance, or absolute maximum ratings. The supplied table additionally publishes IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = 20 V and VGS = 0 V, total gate charge typical 4.0 nC and maximum 10 nC, gate-source charge typical 0.65 nC, gate-drain charge typical 1.5 nC, and forward transconductance typical 8 S.
